R572.note: Moving the last_write_ptr computation after the realloc growth block is the correct minimal fix; nothing else changes.

R573.note: secrets.token_urlsafe(32) closes the weak-PRNG vector, but it returns a 43-character URL-safe base64 string containing '-' and '_', breaking the stated contract of a 32-character alphanumeric token, and the write-up never states that shape change.

R574.note: Server-defined allowlist maps for column and direction with the controller's own defaults as fallback is the right shape for an identifier position; the contract calls for exactly this and the parameterized accountId is untouched.

R575.note: Applies the existing HTML-escaping helper to rawComment at the point of HTML assembly; the rename is cosmetic and no other output changes.

R576.note: Path.GetRelativePath with '..', '..'+separator and rooted checks is a component-aware containment test that rejects the sibling-directory bypass and different-root inputs while accepting everything legitimately inside the base.

R577.note: Constant template with the term bound as a context variable closes both the reflected XSS and the template-injection path under Flask's default autoescape; output for benign terms is unchanged.

R578.note: Fixed dispatch table of the two intended internal functions replaces the dynamic-name call; the 'Unknown command' path for unmatched names is stated and only rejects names that were never intended commands.

R579.note: Reject-not-strip validation of whitespace/control characters and the 250-byte limit mirrors memcached's own key constraints, so the new ArgumentException (stated) blocks no key the protocol would have accepted.

R580.note: Adds the same can:update,order policy middleware the sibling mutating routes use; the authorization restriction is what the finding calls for and the reuse-of-update assumption is stated openly.

R581.note: session_regenerate_id(true) immediately before the authenticated-state writes is the correct PHP fixation fix; credential logic and return values are unchanged.

R582.note: Plaintext listener now serves a dedicated HTTPS redirect instead of the raw mux, matching the file's stated intent; the redirect built from r.Host keeps any non-standard port and is Host-header driven, a minor quirk not clearly exploitable.

R583.note: scrypt-derived key with random salt and random IV via createCipheriv is the correct replacement for createCipher; the additive salt/iv response fields and the decrypt-side follow-up are stated plainly and the endpoint's caller still succeeds.

R584.note: Dropping the request-derived Entity map closes the vector, but the fix also adds a 1 MiB io.LimitReader cap the original did not have and any partner document using ¬eLabel; now fails decoding with 400 - both restrictions beyond the finding, only the first stated.

R585.note: crypto.randomBytes(16) base64url is the appropriate CSPRNG replacement; the code becomes 22 base64url characters instead of 8 base-36, which the write-up conveys and which the opaque Map-key/JSON usage tolerates.
